welcome.header: Imagine waking up knowing exactly what your skin needs.
welcome.body: No guessing. No wasted money. Just healthy, glowing skin — backed by science and built around you.
welcome.footer: 🔒 Your answers stay private and are used only to personalize your plan.

name.question: Let's get acquainted. What's your first name?
name.why: We'll personalize your skin journey — and celebrate your progress — by name.

greeting.text: 👋 Hi, {{name}}. So glad you're here. Let's take a quiet moment to focus on you.
greeting.textNoName: 👋 Hi there. So glad you're here. Let's take a quiet moment to focus on you.

birthday.question: When's your birthday, {{name}}?
birthday.why: Your skin's needs change with each decade — we calibrate ingredient strength and priorities to where you are now.

gender.question: Who are we creating this plan for?
gender.why: Biology shapes your skin's needs — this helps us calibrate correctly.

she.label: Woman
she.desc: Tailored to female skin biology and hormonal patterns

location.question: Where do you live?
location.why: Climate, UV, and humidity all shape what your skin needs. We use your location to personalize your recommendations.
location.fact: People in humid climates often need a very different routine than those in dry climates.

input.label: City
input.noMatch: No match found — you can still continue with this city.

work_environment.question: Tell us about your day.
work_environment.why: Your skin faces different challenges depending on where you spend your time — UV, air conditioning, pollution, dehydration.
work_environment.fact: Air conditioning can increase skin dehydration, while outdoor work raises UV exposure and pigmentation risk.

chapter_2.headline: Now let's understand your skin's story.

interests.question: What would you love to achieve for your skin?

routine_that_works.label: Build a routine that actually works

stop_wasting_money.label: Stop wasting money on products that don't work

discover_needs.label: Discover what my skin really needs

use_what_i_own.label: Make better use of what I already own

tone.question: Let's find your Fitzpatrick skin type.
tone.why: This helps us personalize your SPF, pigmentation prevention, and treatment safety.

post_cleanse_feel.question: How does your skin feel 30 minutes after cleansing?
post_cleanse_feel.why: This reveals your natural skin type — and tells us which cleanser and moisturizer are right for you.
post_cleanse_feel.tip: For the most accurate answer, cleanse gently and wait 30 minutes without applying anything.

irritants.question: What tends to trigger your skin?
irritants.why: We'll steer your plan away from ingredients and treatments likely to set your skin off.
irritants.fact: Sensitive skin isn't a skin type — it describes how your skin reacts to triggers.

skin_goals.question: Which skin concerns do you have right now?
skin_goals.why: We'll build your plan around these — in the right order, at the right pace.

top_concern.question: {{name}}, which one should we focus on first?
top_concern.questionNoName: Which one should we focus on first?
top_concern.why: Your plan will target this first — the rest follow in the right sequence.
top_concern.fact: Treating concerns in the right order — barrier first — is how results stick.

chapter_3.headline: A little about your health — this stays private.

diagnosed_conditions.question: Have you ever been diagnosed with any of these skin conditions?
diagnosed_conditions.why: This helps us recommend safer products and treatments for your skin.

health_conditions.question: Some health conditions can influence your skin. Do any of these apply?
health_conditions.why: Skin health starts inside the body — this helps us understand internal factors affecting yours.
health_conditions.footer: 🔒 Private, and used only to personalize your recommendations.

allergies.question: Are there any ingredients or products your skin reacts to?

hormones.question: {{name}}, a few hormone questions — this is where skincare gets truly personal.
hormones.questionNoName: A few hormone questions — this is where skincare gets truly personal.
hormones.why: Hormones influence oil production, pigmentation, sensitivity, and which ingredients are safe for you.
hormones.footer: 🔒 Private, and used only to personalize your plan.

chapter_4.headline: Your skin doesn't exist in a vacuum. Let's look at the whole picture.

sleep.question: How many hours do you sleep?
sleep.why: Sleep drives skin repair, collagen production, and your barrier's overnight recovery.
sleep.fact: Most skin repair and collagen production happens while you sleep.

stress.question: How stressed have you been lately?
stress.why: Stress can affect breakouts, redness, healing, and premature aging.
stress.fact: Stress raises cortisol, which can affect oil production, inflammation, and your skin barrier.

water_intake.question: How much water do you drink daily?
water_intake.why: Hydration supports overall health and can influence how your skin feels — especially if it runs dry.

alcohol.question: How often do you drink alcohol?
alcohol.why: Alcohol can affect hydration, inflammation, sleep quality, and skin recovery.
alcohol.fact: Alcohol can worsen dehydration and redness in some people — especially with rosacea or sensitive skin.

smoke.question: Do you smoke?
smoke.why: Smoking affects collagen, healing speed, and skin oxygen supply — it changes what your routine should prioritize.

exercise.question: How often do you move your body?
exercise.why: Exercise boosts circulation and skin oxygenation — and tells us how sweat fits into your routine.

chapter_5.headline: Last step — let's see what you're working with.

routine_products.question: What's in your routine right now?
routine_products.why: We'll tell you what to keep, replace, or retire.
routine_products.hint: No judgment — tap everything you use.

event.question: Getting ready for something special?
event.why: A real deadline lets us pace your plan to peak exactly on time.

event_date.question: When's the big day?
event_date.why: We'll build your plan to peak right on time.

photos.question: {{name}}, let's see your skin.
photos.why: Your photos become your baseline — the starting point we'll measure every week of progress against.
photos.footer: 🔒 Photos are private and only used for your analysis.

shelf.question: Now, show us your shelf.
shelf.why: We'll audit every product — ingredient quality, compatibility, duplicates, correct order — and flag anything working against your skin.

completion.headline: {{name}}, your Skin Longevity Plan is ready.
completion.headlineNoName: Your Skin Longevity Plan is ready.
